content.json:
## MiniBank – SLA and Failure Rate
Demo application with synthetic data, Application Insights **appi-minibank**. SLA target: 99.9 % of business requests on minibank-api (Transfer, QRIS, Statement, Login) without a technical failure (HTTP 5xx) and P95 below 1,000 ms. Business declines such as Insufficient balance (HTTP 409) are shown separately: they are correct answers of the bank, not failures, and do not use the error budget.

parameters.name: AppInsights
parameters.label: Application Insights
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.insights/components'
| where name =~ 'appi-minibank'
| project id

content.query:
let biz = requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and name !has "health" and name has "/api/"
| summarize Total = sum(itemCount), Failed = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500), Declines = sumif(itemCount, resultCode == "409"), P95 = percentile(duration, 95);
let avail = availabilityResults
| summarize Runs = sum(itemCount), Passed = sumif(itemCount, tostring(success) =~ "true");
union
 (avail | project Order = 1, Metric = "Availability % (internal probe)", Value = round(100.0 * Passed / Runs, 2)),
 (biz | project Order = 2, Metric = "Technical failure rate % (5xx)", Value = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 2)),
 (biz | project Order = 3, Metric = "Business declines (Insufficient balance)", Value = todouble(Declines)),
 (biz | project Order = 4, Metric = "Success % (SLA 99.9, excl. business declines)", Value = round(100.0 * (Total - Failed) / Total, 3)),
 (biz | project Order = 5, Metric = "P95 latency ms (SLA target 1000)", Value = round(P95, 0))
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: SLA tiles

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api"
| extend Transaction = case(name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", name endswith "/statement", "Statement", name endswith "/api/login", "Login", "")
| where Transaction != ""
| summarize Requests = sum(itemCount), TechnicalFailedPct = round(100.0 * sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500) / sum(itemCount), 2), Declines = sumif(itemCount, resultCode == "409"),
  P50Ms = round(percentile(duration, 50), 0), P95Ms = round(percentile(duration, 95), 0) by Transaction
| extend SlaMet = P95Ms <= 1000 and TechnicalFailedPct <= 0.1
| order by Transaction asc
content.title: P95 latency, technical failures and declines per business transaction

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api"
| extend Transaction = case(name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", name endswith "/statement", "Statement", name endswith "/api/login", "Login", "")
| where Transaction != ""
| summarize P95Ms = percentile(duration, 95) by Transaction, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: P95 latency (ms) per business transaction

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName startswith "minibank-" and name !has "health"
| summarize Total = sum(itemCount), Failed = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500) by cloud_RoleName, bin(timestamp, 5m)
| project timestamp, cloud_RoleName, FailureRatePct = round(100.0 * Failed / Total, 2)
| render timechart
content.title: Technical failure rate % by cloud role (5xx)

content.query:
union
 (requests | where toint(resultCode) >= 500 | summarize Count = sum(itemCount) by cloud_RoleName, Kind = "Failed requests (5xx)"),
 (exceptions | summarize Count = sum(itemCount) by cloud_RoleName, Kind = "Exceptions")
| where cloud_RoleName startswith "minibank-"
| order by cloud_RoleName asc, Kind asc
content.title: Technical failures by cloud role

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and name !has "health" and name has "/api/"
| summarize ['Business declines (409)'] = sumif(itemCount, resultCode == "409"), ['Technical failures (5xx)'] = sumif(itemCount, toint(resultCode) >= 500) by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Business declines (409) vs technical failures (5xx), per 15 minutes

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and resultCode == "409"
| project timestamp, Transaction = case(name endswith "/api/transfer", "Transfer", name endswith "/api/qris/pay", "QRIS", name), Result = "Insufficient balance (409)", DurationMs = round(duration, 0), TraceId = operation_Id
| top 20 by timestamp desc
content.title: Latest business declines (Insufficient balance) with trace ID

content.query:
dependencies
| where tostring(success) =~ "false" and cloud_RoleName startswith "minibank-"
| summarize Failed = sum(itemCount) by cloud_RoleName, type, target, name, resultCode
| top 10 by Failed desc
content.title: Top failed dependencies

content.query:
availabilityResults
| summarize AvailabilityPct = round(100.0 * countif(tostring(success) =~ "true") / count(), 2) by name, bin(timestamp, 15m)
| render timechart
content.title: Availability % (internal probe)

content.json:
### Business impact (IDR)
Failed payments = Transfer and QRIS requests on minibank-api that ended with a technical failure (HTTP 5xx); business declines (409) are not counted. Amount, tier, User ID, amount band and traffic source are request tags set by minibank-api v1.4 before it calls minibank-transfer (customDimensions minibank.amountIdr, minibank.tier, minibank.userId, minibank.amountBand, minibank.trafficSource; in Log Analytics AppRequests.Properties, values as strings). Traffic source: people = real persons on the web page, robot = browser robot, traffic = traffic generator, probe = availability probe. Alert alr-minibank-failed-value-idr fires at IDR 100,000,000 within 10 minutes. The last-10-minute tile needs a time range of 15 minutes or more.

content.query:
let failed = requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]), UserId = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.userId"]);
union
 (failed | summarize Value = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount) | project Order = 1, Metric = "Failed payment value IDR (5xx, time range)", Value),
 (failed | where timestamp > ago(10m) | summarize Value = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount) | project Order = 2, Metric = "Failed payment value IDR (5xx, last 10 min; alert at 100,000,000)", Value),
 (failed | where isnotempty(UserId) | summarize Value = todouble(dcount(UserId)) | project Order = 3, Metric = "Customers affected (User IDs with a failed payment)", Value),
 (failed | summarize Value = todouble(sum(itemCount)) | project Order = 4, Metric = "Failed payments (5xx)", Value)
| extend Value = coalesce(Value, 0.0)
| order by Order asc
| project Metric, Value
content.title: Failed payments in IDR (technical failures only)

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]), UserId = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.userId"]), TierTag = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.tier"])
| summarize FailedValueIdr = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount), FailedPayments = sum(itemCount), CustomersAffected = dcountif(UserId, isnotempty(UserId)) by Tier = iff(isempty(TierTag), "(unknown)", TierTag)
| extend Order = case(Tier == "Solitaire", 1, Tier == "Prioritas", 2, Tier == "Reguler", 3, 4)
| order by Order asc
| project Tier, FailedValueIdr, FailedPayments, CustomersAffected
content.title: Failed payment value by tier

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]), UserId = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.userId"]), BandTag = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.amountBand"])
| summarize FailedValueIdr = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount), FailedPayments = sum(itemCount), CustomersAffected = dcountif(UserId, isnotempty(UserId)) by AmountBand = iff(isempty(BandTag), "(unknown)", BandTag)
| extend Order = case(AmountBand == ">=100M", 1, AmountBand == "10-100M", 2, AmountBand == "1-10M", 3, AmountBand == "<1M", 4, 5)
| order by Order asc
| project AmountBand, FailedValueIdr, FailedPayments, CustomersAffected
content.title: Failed payment value by amount band

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]), UserId = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.userId"]), SourceTag = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.trafficSource"])
| summarize FailedValueIdr = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount), FailedPayments = sum(itemCount), CustomersAffected = dcountif(UserId, isnotempty(UserId)) by TrafficSource = iff(isempty(SourceTag), "(none)", SourceTag)
| extend Order = case(TrafficSource == "people", 1, TrafficSource == "robot", 2, TrafficSource == "traffic", 3, TrafficSource == "probe", 4, TrafficSource == "unknown", 5, 6)
| order by Order asc
| project TrafficSource, FailedValueIdr, FailedPayments, CustomersAffected
content.title: Failed payment value by traffic source

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| extend AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]), TierTag = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.tier"])
| summarize FailedValueIdr = sum(AmountIdr * itemCount) by Tier = iff(isempty(TierTag), "(unknown)", TierTag), bin(timestamp, 5m)
| render timechart
content.title: Failed payment value IDR per 5 minutes by tier

content.query:
requests
| where cloud_RoleName == "minibank-api" and (name endswith "/api/transfer" or name endswith "/api/qris/pay") and toint(resultCode) >= 500
| project timestamp, UserId = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.userId"]), Tier = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.tier"]),
          Channel = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.channel"]), AmountIdr = todouble(customDimensions["minibank.amountIdr"]),
          AmountBand = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.amountBand"]), TrafficSource = tostring(customDimensions["minibank.trafficSource"]),
          ResultCode = resultCode, TraceId = operation_Id
| top 20 by timestamp desc
content.title: Latest failed payments with User ID, tier, amount and trace ID
